name: Breadcrumb trail
definition: A single line of links showing where the current page sits in the site hierarchy, ending in the current page.
bestUse: Deep catalogs, documentation and help centres with three or more levels.

demo.how: Each crumb is a link to a parent level and the last item is the current page, marked as current rather than linked. Click a crumb to go up to that level: the trail shortens and the page title follows. Reset returns to the deepest page. Page names are illustrative.
